{"path": "app.py", "content": "from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
# On the Pi 5 the GPIO controller is on the RP1 southbridge via /dev/gpiochipN;
# legacy mmio-based libraries are broken. gpiozero auto-selects lgpio.
led = LED(17)
led.on()
sleep(1)
"}

text: Fixed: the legacy mmio GPIO library is broken on the Pi 5 because its controller is on the RP1 southbridge. Rewrote the script with gpiozero, which auto-selects the lgpio backend on Pi 5.
